title: This irks me so much
content: I was about to fall asleep and this thought popped in my head and is actually keeping me awake now. Sorry if this doesn’t make much sense, I’m tired and english isn’t my first language Okay so imagine how many thousands, if not millions, of people are out there having Mall World dreams but are unaware of the existence of this sub. Now imagine how many more millions are having Mall World dreams but aren’t open to the idea of this being a special phenomenon- they think of it as any other dream, a normal feature of sleep, and wouldn’t think to dig any deeper than that. Then I started thinking, what if *everyone* is having Mall World dreams? If you believe that we are all one collective consciousness leading back to source… then wouldn’t it be *logical* that everyone is having these dreams? Or at least has experienced them a few times? I don’t think we’ll ever know. See you all at the beach tonight
